name: Eric Schmidt
tagline: The former Google CEO who turned his family office into a frontier-AI and defense-tech vehicle
summary: Eric Schmidt ran Google from 2001 to 2011, served as executive chairman until 2019, and has since become one of the most active individual backers of frontier AI. He invests through two vehicles: Hillspire, his family office, and Innovation Endeavors, the early-stage firm he co-founded with Dror Berman in 2010. His AI activity is concentrated and deliberate — Hillspire has made 22 investments in private AI companies since 2019, and in 2022 alone 13 of his 17 startup investments (more than three-quarters) went to AI, per data shared with CNBC by Fintrx. His positions skew toward frontier labs and capability companies (Anthropic, Mistral, Reflection AI, World Labs, General Intuition), applied deep tech he chairs or advises (SandboxAQ), and defense-adjacent autonomy — a portfolio shaped by his decade chairing the US National Security Commission on Artificial Intelligence. In 2025 he took over as CEO of Relativity Space after acquiring a controlling stake.

thesisHeading: How Eric Schmidt picks AI companies

thesis.heading: Frontier capability and AI safety as one bet
thesis.body: His largest known positions are frontier labs — he joined Anthropic's Series A in May 2021 and is a seed shareholder in Mistral — pairing an AI-safety ethos with a bet that capability concentration still wins.

thesis.heading: Own the hard science layer
thesis.body: Through SandboxAQ (quantum + AI, which he chairs), World Labs (spatial AI) and Goodfire (interpretability), Schmidt funds the research-grade layers of the stack rather than thin wrappers.

thesis.heading: Defense and national security as an AI category
thesis.body: Unusual among angels, he is a prolific backer of defense technology — Rebellion Defense, White Stork and Istari — informed by his government advisory roles, treating military AI as strategically aligned with frontier capability.

thesis.heading: Deploy through two gears
thesis.body: Hillspire writes family-office checks of any size into later rounds; Innovation Endeavors does classic early-stage venture. Both report to the same thesis, which is why Schmidt can appear at a Mistral seed and an Anthropic growth round.
